text: First, we say that we should ban race-based political parties, and the first speaker pointed out that if there were race-based political parties, the voices of some minority or really non-binary people would not be heard, because they are too minority, they are too minor. I want to focus on this point and explain more about this part.

So let's imagine that in the U.S. there are race-based political parties, let's say that there is the Islamic political party, that there is a Native American political party, and then there might be a white political party and an Asian political party as well.

In the current political system, there can be only one president in America, and the president can only come from one party, so only one party will take lead of the country and have actual influence on the country. And since, based on the number of population of race, yes, the white and the black and Hispanics are the majority, while the Islamic people and Hispanic people are weak in numbers, and so it is hard for them to win in presidential elections, I think impossible in numbers.

So that means that Islamic people or Native American people's voice towards big policies of the country, this may be, like, maybe Islamic people are having trouble with food in America because they cannot eat certain foods, like pork, and or they might be facing, like, discrimination because of their, like, behaviors, not behaviors, but their things that they do every day as a Muslim, and they might, they have different views than white or black or Asian people on things.

And if, since, so, and race-based political parties, so, tend to have, like, a very narrow view because it's only based on a single race, so, like I said before, the Muslim or Hispanic people's ideas may not be well voiced out in each policy.

And so, like our first speaker said, if it was an idea-based party, such as liberal or conservative, it's more inclusive compared to race-based political parties, and so the minority people, based on race, they can, their ideas may be more put into action in such inclusive political parties, which leads to a more, a better policy for more people in numbers.
So, we are proud to propose this motion. Thank you.
